name: P.B.C.
description: The Paulina Barry Community (P.B.C.) was a street gang founded in 1965 in the Lake View neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois. The group originated as a social club of 12- and 13-year-olds from the Nelson and Paulina street corner before evolving into a fighting gang. PBC is documented as a rival of the Aristocrats, Simon City Royals, Insane Deuces, Latin Kings, Chi-West, and Maniac Latin Disciples. Around 1976, PBC aligned with the Insane Unknowns, Almighty Popes, and Black Gangster Disciples. The gang was largely extinct by the late 1990s.
